desc: Derive and prove the recursive win/lose characterization using the remaining pass count.
Establish the base cases \(N=1,2,3,4\), carefully handling immediate victory when the final unvisited index is selected.
Prove by induction that for every \(N\ge4\), a state with \(o\) odd-valued unvisited indices and pass count \(p\) is winning exactly when \(p\bmod 2\ne o\bmod 2\).
Verify the characterization against all provided samples and boundary cases.
